question: Who among the following became the first Indian to win a gold medal at the World Athletics Championships event?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neeraj Chopra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Neeraj Chopra became the first Indian to win a gold medal at the World Athletics Championships.
 
• He achieved this milestone in the men's javelin throw event.
 
• Neeraj's winning throw was recorded at 88.17 meters.
 
• He had previously won gold at the Tokyo Olympics 2020, marking his historic achievement in athletics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Athletics Championships**

 
 
• It is a biennial athletics event organized by World Athletics (formerly IAAF).
 
• The event features various track and field competitions, attracting top athletes from around the globe.
 
• The first World Athletics Championships were held in Helsinki, Finland, in 1983.
 
 
 
• **Javelin Throw**
 
 
• Javelin throw is a track and field event where the competitor throws a spear-like implement, called a javelin, as far as possible.
 
• The technique involves a run-up, followed by a throw from behind a designated line.
 
• The javelin must land tip first within a specified sector to be considered a valid throw.
 
 
 
• **Neeraj Chopra's Achievements**
 
 
• Neeraj Chopra won gold at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics, becoming India's first track and field athlete to win an Olympic gold medal.
 
• He is also a Commonwealth Games gold medallist, having won in 2018.
 
• Chopra has been awarded several honors, including the Arjuna Award and the Khel Ratna Award, for his contributions to Indian sports.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Neeraj Chopra's Gold Medal**
 
 
• Neeraj Chopra's gold medal at the World Athletics Championships is a historic achievement for Indian athletics.
 
• It highlights the growing potential and talent in India's track and field athletes on the global stage.
 
• His achievements have inspired a new generation of athletes in India to pursue excellence in sports.
